title: Choose the storefront's visual world
question: The roll assigned Departures from Bergen, the coastal-ferry timetable. Keep it, take Sydvest (my pick), or re-roll. The name on both sketches is Sydvest Kaffebrenneri; you choose the name in the next step.

options.label: Departures from Bergen
options.lineage: the night boards and paper tickets of the coastal ferries leaving Bergen's quay
options.thesis: The shop is tonight's departure board: every coffee a row, the cart a tear-off ticket.
options.viewport: A huge 'Departures from Bergen' head over a live board of the beans and gear, each row with its Add; the ticket (cart) pinned on the right; the counter's hours on the waterline.
options.risk: If the rows are set loosely it reads as a spreadsheet; the board has to be set with a timetable's strictness to feel like a place.

raised.raise: Every price, weight and time sits on one tabular figure grid; the board is two-tone plus the signal yellow, nothing else.
Order status prints itself as board rows (booked, paid, departed, arrived), never as badges.
Every section hangs on one waterline rule that runs the full width of the page.
One line weight across the whole system: board rules, ticket edge and waterline share it.

options.label: Sydvest
options.lineage: the yellow oilskin and sou'wester against Bergen's wet slate streets at four in the afternoon
options.thesis: Oilskin yellow is the shop's coat: it carries the brand and every primary action through the rain.
materials: wet slate with a faint rain streak
options.viewport: A yellow oilskin panel on the left holds the headline and the featured bean's Add; the beans on the right stand on wet slate with a light-to-dark roast scale; the counter's hours glow amber at the foot.
options.risk: The most obvious reading of 'rainy Bergen'; the yellow must stay a material, not a highlighter, or it turns into a hi-vis sale banner.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.lineage: a kiln shelf of glazed cups, each with its recipe card
options.thesis: The beans stand in one row like glazed cups on a kiln shelf, each with its recipe card beside it.
options.viewport: One shelf row across the viewport: each coffee as a cup with its recipe card (origin, process, roast, weight, price, Add).
options.case: Holds product clarity (a spec card per bean is exactly what a buyer reads); loses audience identification, since nothing in it is Bergen, and its chalk-white ground fights the dark default.
options.risk: Light-ground world against a dark-first brief; the ceramics can read as a pottery shop.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: The catalogue as a strobing data field.
options.viewport: Barcode columns with prices in mono.
options.case: No coffee buyer identifies with it and it hides the offer.
options.kept: Total palette discipline and one tabular figure grid.
options.risk: Cold and unreadable as a shop.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.viewport: A prompt that lists the beans.
options.case: A tool costume; buyers do not shop in a terminal.
options.kept: System states print themselves rather than appearing as chrome.

options.label: City-pop Airbrush
options.thesis: A sunset coast road for the beans.
options.viewport: A sunset horizon with the shop's name in chrome.
options.case: A sunny coast is the opposite of the brief's dark rain.
options.kept: Everything hangs on one horizon line.

options.label: Tape J-card
options.thesis: The shop as a photocopied tape inlay.
options.viewport: A folded inlay with the beans as a tracklist.
options.case: Folding panels hide the cart and the prices.
options.kept: One ink weight across the whole system.
options.risk: Lo-fi that undercuts trust at checkout.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.viewport: A glowing disk with products on its rim.
options.case: Spectacle unrelated to coffee or Bergen.
options.kept: An order is shown crossing one threshold after another.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A specialty roaster's shop as the category ships it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A big bag shot beside a headline and a Shop beans button, a row of product cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other roaster, and light by default against the brief.
